title: Microverse Component Tree v2
description: Append-only catalog of fixed-arity manufactured components. Every recipe consumes three exact whole Resource stacks, spends one unit from one terminal catalyst, and consumes one active root-skill use from a Ship.

object_semantics.material_consumption: Each material is an input object constrained to the listed resource code and exact amount; the complete stack is consumed.
object_semantics.reusable_catalyst_mode: Require catalyst amount greater than 1, mutate amount to amount minus 1, rotate its key, and return the successor catalyst.
object_semantics.final_catalyst_mode: Require catalyst amount exactly 1 and consume the catalyst input without a successor.
object_semantics.ship_skill_gate: Require the listed active root skill on the input MicroverseShip, emit its replacement Ship with active_skill_type reset to 0, and increment action_serial.
object_semantics.branching: None. Reusable and final catalyst cases are separate fixed actions.

validation_contract.component_codes: Exactly the contiguous integers 390 through 434 with no collisions.
validation_contract.fixed_arity: Exactly three ordered material rows and exactly one catalyst per component.
validation_contract.whole_stack_reachability: Every material resource code and amount must be emitted together by at least one fixed refinement action.
validation_contract.terminal_catalysts: Every catalyst must be a tier-1 terminal, non-composite Resource.
validation_contract.cross_body_materials: The intersection of the three materials' possible_source_bodies sets must be empty, so no single body can supply the full recipe.
validation_contract.skill_gate: Exactly one existing root skill code is active for each component.
validation_contract.vdf: Tier 1 uses solid/8, tier 2 uses advanced/12, and tier 3 uses artifact/32.
validation_contract.sdk_constraints: Static literal wrappers only; no loops, runtime branching, modulo, or dynamic action routing.

ui.quantity_note: Material quantities are whole-object amounts, not deductions from a larger stack.
